# graylog Provider

The Graylog provider configures Graylog resources via its REST API. It supports Graylog 6.x and aims for forward compatibility with 7.x.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "graylog" {
  endpoint = "https://graylog.example.com/api"
  username = "admin"
  password = "secret"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM-encoded CA certificate to trust for the Graylog server's TLS certificate.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Graylog REST API (e.g. `https://graylog.example.com/api`). Can also be set via the `GRAYLOG_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to `false`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for HTTP Basic authentication. Can also be set via the `GRAYLOG_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `timeout` (Number) HTTP request timeout in seconds. Defaults to `30`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token for bearer authentication. Mutually exclusive with username/password. Can also be set via the `GRAYLOG_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for HTTP Basic authentication. Can also be set via the `GRAYLOG_USERNAME` environment variable.
